400.title: Bad Request
400.description: The server couldn't understand your request. Please check your input and try again.

401.title: Unauthorized
401.description: You need to sign in to access this resource. Please authenticate and try again.

403.title: Access Denied
403.description: You don't have permission to access this resource. Contact your administrator if you believe this is an error.

404.title: Not Found
404.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.

408.title: Request Timeout
408.description: The server took too long to respond. Please check your connection and try again.

500.title: Server Error
500.description: Something went wrong on our end. Our team has been notified and is working on it.

502.title: Bad Gateway
502.description: We're having trouble connecting to our servers. Please try again in a moment.

503.title: Service Unavailable
503.description: The service is temporarily unavailable. We're working to restore it as quickly as possible.

default.title: Something Went Wrong
default.description: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again or contact support if the problem persists.

notFound.title: Page Not Found
notFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved to a different location.
notFound.hint: Lost? Try using the navigation menu or search for what you need.
